---
name: Feature request
about: Something MERIDIAN doesn't do today that you wish it did.
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

A clear description of the workflow you're trying to support and why
the current toolkit doesn't quite fit.

## A solution you'd like

Describe what you imagine the feature looking like — CLI flag, new
launcher prompt, new template variant, new mail backend, ...

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried working around it? What did you do, and what made it
unsatisfactory?

## Audience

- [ ] This affects me as an editor at the originating institution
- [ ] This affects me as a maintainer of a fork at another institution
- [ ] This is a generic improvement that would benefit any user

## Additional context

Screenshots, mail-client quirks, related issues / PRs.
